recognize_zh: CD3 免疫染色：散在與成片的小 T 淋巴球呈膜陽性，而夾雜其中的大型漿母細胞樣細胞（核大、泡狀、核仁明顯）完全不染，證明這些大細胞不是 T 細胞；是 germinotropic LPD 免疫組合中的陰性對照。
features: Membranous CD3 staining in numerous small reactive T lymphocytes
Large atypical plasmablastic cells with vesicular nuclei and nucleoli are CD3 negative
T cells denser in one region (interfollicular) and scattered within the follicular area
No aberrant CD3 expression in large cells
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD3 highlights numerous small reactive T lymphocytes with membranous staining, more densely in interfollicular areas and scattered within the follicular region. The admixed large atypical cells, with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, are negative for CD3. This excludes a T-cell origin for the large cells. In the context of HHV8 LANA-1 and EBER positivity with lack of B-cell antigens, the findings support HHV8-positive germinotropic lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with large cells
ddx.vs: In PTCL the large atypical cells themselves express CD3 (or show aberrant loss of other T-cell antigens), whereas here they are CD3 negative.
THRLBCL has scattered large CD20+ B cells in a T-cell and histiocyte-rich background and is HHV8 negative, while the large cells here lack B-cell antigens and are HHV8 positive.
HRS cells are CD30+/CD15+, weak PAX5+ and HHV8 negative, often rosetted by CD3+ T cells.
